title: Day 11.5 - AI/Algo Trading (Paper) weekend update
author: Enzobevmax
selftext:
What a week. Biggest(in trade count) one yet, and the system is getting sharper at spotting the moves before they happen.

**Week in a nutshell:**

* 5,161 live trades, the biggest week yet (3,865 · 3,287 · 4,081 · **5,161** since the week of 10/12).
* 168 setups traded this week, long and short.
* 2% to 26%: share of the day's big moves we caught, 11/5 to 11/6.

**Yes, there were a lot of losses so here are a few wins this week:**

* \+10.8R: Claude's Team, day 1. Claude, the AI that runs MCF, hand-picked its own dream team of setups (simulated shadow, no real orders). It skipped both Early Sellers setups. Clever, eh?
* \+51.8R: Gap-Down Recovery Fade (all day), last 14 sessions (1 big day).
* \+38.6R: Gap-Down Pop Fade, Heavy Selling (all day) (1 big day).
* \+31.7R: Gap-Down Early Bounce Short (all day), 5 green sessions in a row.
* \+30.9R: Gap-Down Pop Fade (all day) (1 big day).
* \+16.1R: Gap-Down Bounce Short, Heavy Selling (all day), green 10 of 14.
* \+10.0R and +3.1R: Testing 1 and Testing 2 on the quiet days.

**What we learned:**

* Two rough days had the same cause: too many shorts in one direction right into a squeeze. **Now we know where to aim.**
* The safety stops and the restart fix worked live. So could have been a lot worse.
* **Fun fact we determined from our back tests -** \~89%: once SPY moves 0.30%+ from the open, it stays on that side. A real compass for picking setups by market.

**Coming up:**

* A full Primary review is done and ready for Monday.
* Hunch keeps learning every 3 minutes: 46,600+ guesses so far, aiming for 65%+guesses for 3 minute bars
* Setup Generator paused for now (overcrowding), so existing setups get a fair test.

Paper trading, R after costs. Rule changes inside these windows: Primary lot \~$4k (10/28), -2R per-setup stop (10/29), Testing 2 top-500 pool (11/4), Explore 1 / Live Lab (11/5).

As always, thanks so much for the support and input!

Fun stuff!
